result:
I did not get every screen to 4, so this task is only partly done. I shipped nothing this run.

I re-shot the current build and ran the critic on two screens. Settings (72) scored 3 and Pad buttons (74) scored 2. The earlier scores still stand for the rest: 18, 25, 26, 32, 42 and 49 are at 3, and 75 is at 2. Screens 27–31, 68–71 and 73 share the same shell and were never scored on their own.

The critic's findings are the ones I had already logged as stuck. In this run's calls it only saw the old picture, so it could not compare before and after.

One item on my earlier to-do list is already done: row names are 20px and rows are 56px.

What would move the scores:
- **Settings list height:** snap it to whole rows so the last row isn't cut off.
- **Screens 74 and 75:** a staging change so the pad focus state shows in the shots.
- **Key hints:** real keycap elements instead of the current text hint.
- **Pad buttons:** pad glyph chips in place of the text labels.

These need layout or staging choices rather than small CSS changes. They would also move buttons he laid out, such as "Send play data" and the five pause-box buttons. The critic has also contradicted itself on the backdrop dim and the section labels. My notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/c-31-ui-pause-settings.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: whole-row list snap, pad focus staging for 26/74/75, keycap elements for key hints, and pad glyph chips are still open.
